Name: (CP) green haven farm
Author: havenonames
Description:
[b][font=Georgia][color=#6aa84f][size=3]green haven (vanilla|SVE):[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6aa84f]●[/color] farm type: Wilderness (Combat) only
[color=#6aa84f]●[/color] features: light sourses, water sourses, hot spring
(forest forage spawn, grass grow during winter)
[color=#6aa84f]●[/color] optional pet house (false|true)[/size][/font]

[b][font=Georgia][color=#f1c232][size=3]Luna ([b][font=Georgia][color=#f1c232][size=3]SVE)[/size][/color][/font][/b]:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Verdana][size=2][color=#f1c232]●[/color] farm type: Wilderness (Combat) only
[color=#f1c232]●[/color] features: quarry, light sourses, water sourses, hot spring
(forest forage spawn, grass grow during winter, renewable resources)
[/size][/font]
[b][font=Georgia][color=#6fa8dc][size=3]some info:[/size][/color][/font][/b]
[font=Verdana][size=2][color=#6fa8dc]●[/color] probably works well with all custom caves & all recoloring mods & in multiplayer
(but: for multiplayer i recommend not start with more than three houses)
[color=#6fa8dc]●[/color] didn't play SVE so the SVE ver was made based on feedback
[color=#6fa8dc]●[/color] android? still not tested[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][color=#e69138][size=3][b]installation & play:[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Verdana][size=2][color=#e69138]●[/color] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's tilesheets[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]FTM[/url] (for SVE Luna only)

[color=#e69138]●[/color] edit config.json if you wanna change defaults
[color=#e69138]●[/color] run game with SMAPI
[color=#e69138]●[/color] create a new character & skip intro[/size][/font]
